Elena Torres: Heads-up 0pt: I'm assembling a single playbook for the upcoming marketplace launch + partner co-marketing. Need to confirm owners for: listing copy, landing page variant, partner quote collection, and press outreach.
Ben Wu: I can own press outreach and blog. Will pair with product for the technical callouts. Need partner-approved quote by Wed so we can lock the draft.
Priya Nair: Product will provide 2 technical bullets and a short customer quote draft. Also: confirm whether marketplace listings should mention Dedicated & Private SKUs or link to our docs only.
Elena Torres: Good Q. Partners prefer a single listing pointing to marketplace SKUs; we'll also have a separate landing page for Dedicated/Private options. That landing page must include the partner logo zone and an "Explore solutions" CTA that routes to the correct marketplace (aws/gcp/azure).
Omar Khalid: Engineering will supply console screenshots and a short GIF of the provisioning flow. ETA EOD Tue. Also flag: hardware partner requires a note about supported GPU families (A100/T4) in the listing.
Nina Patel: Finance needs final SKU mappings for trials/promos to publish on marketplace. I'll coordinate with billing to get the trial->paid transitions documented.
Tess (partners-bot): Reminder: Playbook template created: https://tasks.redwood.ai/playbooks/marketplace-joint-launch. Open items: partner quote, SKU csv, trademark signoff, EU localization.
Ben Wu: Press embargo suggestion: Thursday 09:00 PT. That aligns with APAC morning and EU afternoon. If legal signs off earlier we can move up. Thoughts?
Priya Nair: Thursday works. One ask: add a short technical FAQ on the landing page about latency/SLOs and region availability. Product will draft.
Elena Torres: Action owners: Ben = press/blog/social; Priya = technical bullets + FAQ; Omar = assets (screenshots/GIF + GPU note); Nina = SKU & billing mapping; Elena = partner packet + trademark approvals. Deadline: Wed 5pm PT for handoff.
Omar Khalid: Quick note on integrations: SI partners asked for a pre-baked terraform module. That's a separate deliverable but should be linked from the marketplace landing page. I'll add a short install section.
Ben Wu: For the blog, let's include a small callout about marketplace discounts for the first 90 days. Nina, confirm discount codes so I can write them generically (e.g., "intro promo").
Nina Patel: Will confirm promo cadence. FYI marketplace sometimes forbids explicit %-off in listing meta; we'll use legal-approved phrasing.
Tess (partners-bot): Checklist status: 9 open, 5 in progress, 2 blocked (trademark, SKU csv). Next auto-reminder in 24h.
Elena Torres: Also we need UTM + tracking plan for marketplace referrals. Ben, can you add tracking params for the CTAs? We'll want to feed performance into the partner dashboard.
Ben Wu: Yep 0action: I'll add utm_source=marketplace&utm_medium=listing&utm_campaign=marketplace_launch_2026 and pass to analytics. Add an offline conversion tag for partner leads.
Priya Nair: One more: partner wants a co-hosted webinar planned 2 weeks post-launch. Add to timeline and promotional calendar.
Elena Torres: Added. Final question for landing page: do we want a small path for SOC2/compliance info for enterprise buyers? Product and legal input needed.
Omar Khalid: We'll provide a short compliance snippet and link to full docs. I'll put it in the assets drop.
Nina Patel: Finance also wants to confirm reporting IDs so marketplace revenue shows correctly in our ledger. I'll push the mapping today.
Ben Wu: Great. I'll draft the press + blog and share Monday for review. If partner quote is late, I'll use an early-access customer quote placeholder.
Tess (partners-bot): Slack reminder set for Wed 16:00 PT: final asset handoff. Playbook state archived after handoff.
Elena Torres: Thanks team 0thumbsup: we'll do a 20-min sync Wed 4:30 PT to review everything before handoff. If anyone is blocked, DM me.
